subject: Urgent: TidalFlow production throughput surge — request for regional redispatch and exec sync
messages:
From: Erin Walsh <erin@tidalflow.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@tidalflow.com
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 07:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: sustained latency and 500s in us-east-1 — immediate help needed

Marcus —

We started seeing a sustained throughput surge beginning ~06:40 PDT across our checkout routes hitting Redwood's us-east-1 cluster. Error rates rose from ~0.2% to 7% and median latency jumped from 120ms to ~1.8s. We're seeing spikes of 5xx responses returned to customers. This is impacting live checkouts (payment step) and we've already got several customer-facing incidents.

Our engineers rolled back a recent model flag on our side (no change). From the app side it looks like token-level retries are amplifying traffic into us-east-1 and KV cache hit rates dropped significantly. We opened a PagerDuty incident: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8672

Can Redwood do an emergency regional rehome / temporary routing to another region while you investigate? We need a target timeline (ETA) for mitigation and an exec contact for esca- lation.

Attachments: tidalflow_error_logs_20290508.zip (sample logs, 2MB)

— Erin Walsh
CTO, TidalFlow

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: Erin Walsh <erin@tidalflow.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 07:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sustained latency and 500s in us-east-1 — immediate help needed

Erin — thanks for the quick heads up and the logs. I've opened an internal incident and prioritized a cross-team bridge. High-level response now:

- Immediate: We can route TidalFlow's production prefix off us-east-1 to us-west-3 (wider capacity, lower contention) as a temporary mitigation. This will require a DNS/smart-router update and will take ~12–20 minutes to cutover with a staged canary.
- Investigation: Infra and serving-runtime teams will take a forensic look into KV cache pressure and the recent kernel selection changes around 06:30 PDT.
- Exec: looping in Soojin for an executive touchpoint and to coordinate customer comms/credits.

I will start the rehome plan now — initiating 'regional-redispatch v3' (playbook attached). Expect status updates every 10 minutes until cutover completes.

Attachments: redispatch_playbook_v3.pdf

— Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, Erin Walsh <erin@tidalflow.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 07:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sustained latency and 500s in us-east-1 — immediate help needed

Marcus / Erin — noted. I'm standing up the routing change with network ops now. Plan:

1) Open canary (5% traffic) to us-west-3 — validate error-rate and P95 latency over 5 minutes.
2) If green, ramp to 50% over 10 minutes, monitoring: 5xx rate, integration timeout errors, and KVCACHE misses.
3) Full cutover to 100% if metrics are stable for 10 minutes.

I'll post metrics to the Bridge. Monica, please prepare a rollback plan and a short comms blurb we can send to TidalFlow customers if needed.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin@tidalflow.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sustained latency and 500s in us-east-1 — immediate help needed

Erin — So sorry you're seeing this. I'm on the call with execs and can join the bridge in 10. A few things from our side:

- We'll treat this as an executive-priority incident. I'll coordinate a credit proposal depending on duration and business impact.
- Please confirm whether TidalFlow wants Redwood to perform the DNS/Router change (we can) or if your networking team will trigger it. We recommend Redwood execute to ensure the staged canary runs cleanly.
- We'll provide an internal RCA (with timeline) within 72 hours and a postmortem with mitigations in 7 days.

If you consent, Redwood will take the rehome action immediately.

— Soojin Lee
VP, Sales & Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Erin Walsh <erin@tidalflow.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: ops@tidalflow.com, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 08 May 2029 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Production: sustained latency and 500s in us-east-1 — immediate help needed

Thanks — we authorize Redwood to proceed with the staged rehome. Please keep us on the bridge and provide an expected completion ETA. Also confirm whether any session affinity or token signing keys will be affected during the move (we need to avoid double-charges).

We appreciate the quick response — our ops lead (cc) will monitor checkout flows and run synthetic traffic.

— Erin Walsh
CTO, TidalFlow
